# Evercraft Opportunity Fabric

Product key: opportunity-fabric
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/opportunity-fabric
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/opportunity-fabric/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/opportunity-fabric/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- I have designs and need a printer or manufacturing partner
- find a production partner for my artwork
- I have songs or demos and need a producer or recording studio
- find collaborators near me who can help finish this project
- I have equipment or unused capacity and want complementary work
- I need a subcontractor or specialist so I can execute this job
- I have intellectual property but do not want to give it away while looking for partners
- help me turn this unfinished idea or asset into an executable team
- find licensing production distribution or collaboration opportunities for work I already made
- assemble several accepted partners into one execution team
- break this project into work packages for different partners
- coordinate a designer printer fulfillment partner and retailer on one project
- build a music team with a producer studio engineer and videographer

## Authority

public capability discovery plus verified private metadata-first multi-party execution assembly; no public protected-file delivery, payment, or final legal-agreement authority is claimed

## Boundaries

- public matching must not require protected creative files or confidential material
- uploading listing viewing matching or forming a team does not transfer ownership or grant commercial rights
- protected disclosure remains gated and actual protected-file delivery is not exposed as a public production workflow
- Creator Covenant legal language remains draft_for_counsel_review
- public Base44 deployment URL is not yet claimed
- fingerprint vault evidence support is not copyright registration patent filing or dispositive proof of ownership
- multi-party team creation requires already-accepted source relationships
- each counterparty must accept the specific team invitation before receiving a work package
- work-package acceptance does not grant intellectual-property rights or disclose protected material
- actual protected-file delivery remains disabled

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
